"Gudilo Badilo Madilo Vodilo" Song With Lyrics from DJ – Duvvada Jagannadham is a mesmerizing melody featuring Allu Arjun and Pooja Hegde. Composed by DSP and sung by MLR Karthikeyan & Chitra, this soulful track is pure musical magic. Listen and enjoy!
Song: Gudilo Badilo
Movie - DJ Duvvada Jagannadham
Cast - Allu Arjun, Pooja Hegde
Screenplay - Ramesh Reddy, Deepak Raj
Story - Dialogues - Direction: Harish Shankar
Cinematography : Ayananka Bose
Music : Devi Sri Prasad
